ext_description.message: A visual workspace for organizing your tabs and bookmarks into collections with cloud sync. Better than bookmarks.

save_session_title.message: Save all open tabs as a session

at_least_one_space.message: You must have at least one space.

cloud_not_configured.message: Dooby Cloud is not enabled in this build. Chrome's own sync still keeps your bookmarks in step across desktop Chromes.

cloud_err_session_expired.message: Session expired, please sign in again

settings_desc.message: Preferences for this device. Bookmarks themselves still sync as usual.

setting_close_tab_hint.message: When you quick-save from the toolbar icon or drag an open tab into a collection.

setting_collection_sort_hint.message: Pinned collections always stay on top.

setting_tab_sort_hint.message: Pinned tabs always stay on top. Drag-to-reorder works in Manual mode.

no_duplicates.message: No duplicate URLs found. Your collections are clean!

import_toby_confirm.message: Import {folders} collections with {tabs} bookmarks from Toby?

import_replace_confirm.message: Import {spaces} spaces and {collections} collections? This will replace your current data.

export_import_desc.message: Backup your data or transfer to another device.
